final: SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () - AVG(1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ()) OVER () AS distance_from_average_share FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan
